laws: Machine reality is what can be built, run, checked, measured, and evidenced.
A toolchain is not available because an LLM names it; it is available when Mechanicus proves it locally.
A language must have a declared role and validation lane.
A UI shell, game shell, CLI shell or launcher may change without changing functional truth.
Functional truth lives below surfaces in receipts, registries, contracts, validators and tools.
No monolith may be accepted as normal architecture.
Fast result is secondary to working, maintainable, provable result.

polymorphism_law.core_sentence: Form may change; function must not be lost.
